As a logistic employee, you will work in a warehouse and start in the Value Added Services (VAS) department. Your tasks include checking goods, loading and unloading containers, and applying stickers to products. Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that all products are processed correctly.

This is a full-time position from Monday to Friday, working the day shift from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM. On your first working day, you will work from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and be paired with a buddy who will guide you through all tasks and procedures. - 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM
